IndexPage.title:
Disciplined Software

Development with AI Coding
IndexPage.description: Claude Code, skills, TDD, vertical slices, and AFK agent workflows. Four comprehensive guides applicable at every level — from individual developers to team models.

cards.title: Claude Code Agentic Project Setup
cards.subtitle: Folder structure · CLAUDE.md · Skills · Agents
cards.desc: An agentic development template you can copy into any new project. 7 skill files, 5 agent definitions, a CLAUDE.md template, docs folder structure, and Windows/macOS setup commands in one document.

cards.title: Disciplined Development with AI Coding
cards.subtitle: Core problems · 7-stage workflow · AFK agent
cards.desc: Smart Zone / Dumb Zone, the Grill Me technique, horizontal vs. vertical slicing, the TDD feedback loop, and deep module architecture. Stage 0 through Stage 6: idea → PRD → issues → TDD → AFK → architecture review.

cards.title: Best Practices and Team Model
cards.subtitle: Skill map · Playbooks · Areas of responsibility
cards.desc: 6 things to always do, 6 things to never do, playbooks for simple and large features, a 5-dimension skill map (A–E), a team responsibility table, and the Alignment → Merge summary formula.

cards.title: Building a Project with Matt Pocock Skills
cards.subtitle: /grill-with-docs · /to-prd · /tdd · /diagnose
cards.desc: A complete skill workflow through a URL Shortener example. /setup, /grill-with-docs, /to-prd, /to-issues, /tdd, /triage, /improve-codebase-architecture, and supporting skills — with real terminal output.

cards.title: Agentic Development Cheat Sheet
cards.subtitle: Rules · Skills · Agents · Hooks · Plugins
cards.desc: A practical after-session reference: the mental model behind rules/skills/agents/hooks, a copyable folder structure and setup commands, CLAUDE.md and settings.json templates, and full skill/agent definitions.
